summary: Describes test cases for evaluating congestion control algorithms for interactive real-time RTP media in a controlled environment. It is informational and works with the evaluation guidelines in RFC 8868.

eli5.summary: Before letting a new video-call traffic rule loose on the real Internet, you try it on a practice track. This document lists the practice courses to test it on.

questions: test cases for rtp congestion control
how to test real-time media congestion control
